Thanks to MSI for sponsoring this video. Check out the firm's Summer Kick-Off sale here: https://msi.gm/DF_The_Summer_Kickoff_Sale

Audi Sorlie is back, with a deep dive into the brilliant Commodore 64, joined by guest @bastichb64k and legendary composer Chris Huelsbeck. The trio discuss the origins of the C64, the impact it had on the industry and its current revival. And of course, with Chris Huelsbeck on the panel, there's a special focus on the C64's amazing audio capabilities.
